lines.en: At last firemen have put out a big forest fire in California.
lines.zh: 消防队员们终于扑灭了加利福尼亚的一场森林大火。

lines.en: Since then, they have been trying to find out how the fire began.
lines.zh: 从那时起，他们一直试图找出起火的原因。

lines.en: Forest fires are often caused by broken glass or by cigarette ends which people carelessly throw away.
lines.zh: 森林火灾时常由破碎的玻璃或人们随手扔掉的香烟头引起。

lines.en: Yesterday the firemen examined the ground carefully, but were not able to find any broken glass.
lines.zh: 昨天，消防队员仔细查看了地面，但未能发现碎玻璃。

lines.en: They were also quite sure that a cigarette end did not start the fire.
lines.zh: 他们还十分肯定火灾也不是由烟头引起的。

lines.en: This morning, however, a fireman accidentally discovered the cause.
lines.zh: 然而今天上午，一个消防队员偶然发现了起火的原因。

lines.en: He noticed the remains of a snake which was wound round the electric wires of a 16,000-volt power line.
lines.zh: 他发现了缠绕在16,000伏高压线上的一条死蛇。

lines.en: In this way, he was able to solve the mystery.
lines.zh: 就这样，他解开了起火之谜。

lines.en: The explanation was simple but very unusual.
lines.zh: 解释很简单，却异乎寻常。

lines.en: A bird had snatched up the snake from the ground and then dropped it on to the wires.
lines.zh: 一只鸟把蛇从地上抓起来，然后把它扔到了电线上。

lines.en: The snake then wound itself round the wires.
lines.zh: 于是蛇就缠住了几根电线。

lines.en: When it did so, it sent sparks down to the ground and these immediately started a fire.
lines.zh: 当它这样做时，把火花送到了地面，这些火花立刻引起了一场大火。
